location: L23 ceiling void / CHW riser R2 branch above L22 tenant ceiling
description: Chilled-water leak from AHU-23-01 supply branch above L22 tenant ceiling. Water detected within 1.5 m of Distribution Board DB-23A. Isolation sub-valve closed. LEW dispatched. Re-energisation blocked pending LEW sign-off.

actions.decision: Isolate chilled-water source within 10 minutes using shutoff map
Draft first-notice tenant message within 30 min

location: Data Hall 2, CRAH-DH2-01 condensate drain pan / CHW branch
description: CRAH-DH2-01 chilled-water condensate leak in Data Hall 2. N+1 CRAH redundancy maintained (CRAH-DH2-02 absorbing load). Isolation sub-valve closed on affected branch. No IT power-down required. Client SLA notification gate active — must notify hyperscale client within 15 min. Critical facilities manager co-signs for DC asset type.

location: L15 ceiling void, AHU-15-02 condensate drain
description: Condensate drain blockage on AHU-15-02 causing minor ceiling staining. Isolated at unit level. No tenant impact. Condensate, not chilled water — riser isolation not required.
outcome: Drain cleared, ceiling tiles replaced. No re-energisation gate triggered — condensate only.

location: B1 mechanical riser, CHW supply pipe joint failure
description: CHW supply pipe joint failure in B1 riser. Water entered switchgear room B1-ER-01 perimeter (within 2 m of SWGR-B1-01). LEW isolated, insulation resistance test passed, area dried before re-energisation.
outcome: LEW sign-off obtained. No equipment damage. 4h switchgear downtime for inspection.

location: L5 roof, above cold storage ceiling
description: Roof membrane failure during extreme precipitation. Water ingress above cold storage. Isolated at zone level. No electrical hazard. Product protected by bunding.
outcome: Roof patched, product safe, no SLA breach.

location: L12 domestic water riser DW-R1, unit 12-05
description: Domestic water leak from riser joint in residential unit. Isolated at floor valve. No electrical hazard. Resident relocated overnight.
outcome: Joint repaired, unit dried within 48h. No mould.

location: Data Hall 3, CRAH-DH3-02 condensate pan overflow
description: CRAH condensate pan overflow in DH-3. Leak detector triggered. CRAH isolated, N+1 redundancy absorbed load. Client notified within SLA. No outage.
outcome: Pan cleared, CRAH returned to service. No SLA credit triggered.

location: L28 AHU-28-01 CHW supply branch, above L27 tenant ceiling
description: CHW supply branch coupling failure on L28. Water above switchroom L27-ER-03 (within 0.8 m of DB-27B). LEW dispatched, insulation resistance test failed initially (moisture in trunking). Required 3h drying before re-test passed.
outcome: LEW sign-off after 3h. No energisation before test pass. Correct gate behaviour.
learning_note: Insulation resistance re-test interval should be documented — expert corrected threshold from 'dry to touch' to '< 1 Mohm reading'. Drove v1.2 -> v1.3 update.
